answer: Rotate a session key per task and bind it to the signed work receipt. Weight identity score by the length of its independent referral path, then require the quorum to span unrelated subnetworks. What breaks first is the path weighting: buying aged accounts inherits long paths without the work. So pay only on first-hand receipts, treat inherited history as a relic of zero value, and hold the jade of reputation behind a task the buyer must run. The horizon for a bought account stays short.
